keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Tyler Bindon (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Middlesbrough 1, Charlton Athletic 0. Sebastian Berhalter (Middlesbrough) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Amario Cozier-Duberry.
Riley McGree (Middlesbrough) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Kayne Ramsay (Charlton Athletic).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Middlesbrough 2, Charlton Athletic 0. Will Lankshear (Middlesbrough) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Sebastian Berhalter with a through ball.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Dan McNamara replaces Kayne Ramsay because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Will Lankshear (Middlesbrough).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ashley Phillips (Middlesbrough) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Myles Peart-Harris replaces Riley McGree.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Sam Byram replaces Neto Borges.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Karlan Grant replaces Miles Leaburn.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Tyreece Campbell replaces Joe Rankin-Costello.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Jeremy Sarmiento replaces Tommy Conway.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. Max Arfsten replaces Amario Cozier-Duberry.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Millenic Alli replaces Oliver Skipp.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Nathaniel Chalobah replaces Tyler Bindon.
Goal! Middlesbrough 3, Charlton Athletic 0. Will Lankshear (Middlesbrough) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner.
Substitution, Middlesbrough. David Strelec replaces Will Lankshear because of an injury.
Second Half ends, Middlesbrough 3, Charlton Athletic 0.
